# Faith Movement

> > Faith Movement: Catholic catechesis and evangelisation through the theological synthesis of Fr Edward Holloway, integrating faith and reason.

Faith Movement is a Charitable Incorporated Organisation dedicated to Catholic teaching and formation, particularly through the work of Fr Edward Holloway and his theological synthesis 'Catholicism: A New Synthesis'. The organization offers events, publications, and resources exploring fundamental questions of faith, science, and revelation.

## Key Topics

- Fr Edward Holloway
- Catholicism: A New Synthesis
- Catholic catechesis
- Theological synthesis
- Faith and reason
- Christian apologetics
- Faith Summer Session
- Faith Northern Summertime
- Holloway teaching
- Evangelisation
- Salvation history
- God's existence
- Jesus Christ
- Sin and suffering
- Human nature
